scenario: `and` is `false` if any operand is `false` (LNUL.4.2): `x.a > 0 and x.b < 100` holds for (5, 50) only. (-1, 50) has a false left operand and (5, 200) a false right one, so `in_band` fires exactly once. Only `and` is stepped, over non-null operands. Named for the LEXP.2.4 heading (chain length), which it does not test.
rules_ds:
schema Val scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    a: Int mutable
    b: Int mutable

rule in_band:
    Val x where x.a > 0 and x.b < 100
->
    log info "in band"
